query: What compute and sample budgets are required per experiment (env steps to convergence, GPU/CPU counts, parallel sims) and what are expected wall-clock training times?

response.query: What compute and sample budgets are required per experiment (env steps to convergence, GPU/CPU counts, parallel sims) and what are expected wall-clock training times?
response.answer: Compute budget per experiment depends on model complexity; typically, 1-4 GPUs suffice. Training times range from hours to days. Parallel simulations reduce time proportionally.
